focus: Applied Generative AI for Knowledge Workers

summary: Atlassian's October 13 update describes Rovo connecting Slack conversations to Jira, Confluence and other project knowledge. Its examples reconstruct launch decisions, identify risks against plans, create Jira work from discussion and support incident investigation. For newer Slack connectors, results are retrieved directly when needed, subject to each user's underlying Slack permissions.
why_it_matters: A project manager can ask why a milestone changed, then verify the answer against its original thread and tracked ticket. Pilot permission checks with private channels and require review before an agent updates assignments or incident plans.
related_coverage: See companion October 14 coverage for engineering, responsible tasks, knowledge context and safe skills.
image_alt_intent: Traceable project decision from Slack discussion through permission-filtered search into Confluence launch plan and Jira ticket, with risk-update detection, human approval and audit evidence.
